accessReview.notes: The inventory named settings/notification_settings_screen.dart as the primary file. That screen is only the per-user PUSH notification catalogue and contains no WhatsApp invoice-send control. The actual switch is 'Auto-send invoice via WhatsApp' in lib/screens/settings/invoices_settings_screen.dart; that file was read and is the quote source. notification_settings_screen.dart was read and found not to contain the described control.
